svg.title: Public GitHub activity at a glance
svg.desc: 3,920 contributions on 44 active days in the past 12 months, with a longest streak of 23 days. Busiest day: 948 contributions on 2026-11-12. Latest 30 days: 3,390 contributions on 24 active days; previous 30 days: 415 on 6. A bar chart shows each of the latest 91 days with a seven-day average line.
